main.description: Creates an organization, whose handle is a scope on this host, with the caller as its only owner. The host writes its members record and its DID's genesis operation, with any 'recoveryKeys' ranked above the host's rotation keys. Without recovery keys, the host's are the DID's only rotation keys. The members record counts once the caller attests it.

name.description: The scope's name: the first label of the organization's handle.

recoveryKeys.description: Optional recovery keys, held by the owners, ranked first to last above the host's rotation keys. At most three: the host keeps two of a DID's five rotation keys.

errors.name: NameTaken
errors.description: The scope exists, or the host reserves its name.

errors.name: NotAllowed
errors.description: The host's rules do not let the caller create a scope, such as one that needs the operator's approval or a claim on a domain.

errors.name: QuotaExceeded
errors.description: The caller has created as many scopes as the host allows.
